definitions.explanation: A state of severe financial difficulty or want. More formal and emphatic than {貧乏|びんぼう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困窮|こんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be in dire financial straits.

examples.japanese: {困窮|こんきゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Support for families in hardship is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{困窮|こんきゅう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the economic crisis, many households fell into a state of destitution.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly seen in news, government reports, and social welfare contexts. Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({困窮|こんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Stronger and more formal than ⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧ (poor) or ⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧ (poverty).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{困窮|こんきゅう}: living in hardship
- {困窮|こんきゅう}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧: households in poverty
- {困窮|こんきゅう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of destitution
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧{困窮|こんきゅう}: economic hardship
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{困窮者|こんきゅうしゃ}→困窮者：18364_konkyuusha⟧: people in financial hardship
